title: 第十四章 这还是个狼人村庄？
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
“那你还有没有其他同学，校友之类的，给介绍一个呗，待遇好说！”沐游不死心的问。
“这……我尽量吧……”
赵倩没好意思当面拒绝，留下这么一句后，摆手离开。
“可惜啊……”
沐游其实也心知希望不大，像赵倩这类名牌大学毕业生，让他们放下身段来宠物店里打工，确实有点不现实。
“以后再说吧……”
这事只能先放着。
沐游回了店里，和小雅一起招呼剩下的客人。
一直忙到下午送走所有的客人，两人齐齐趴在前台电脑前，清点起了这一天的收获。
这一天下来，店里总共卖出去了十二只仓鼠，七只龙猫，五只兔子，三只金钱龟，六只金丝雀和五条锦鲤。
此外，还有大量的宠物被顾客贴上了预定标签，处于待售状态。
还有就是顾客在购买宠物时，顺带买下的各种宠物用具和饲料。
清点完毕，今天一天的营业额，竟然达到了恐怖的一万五千多，就算减去成本，净利润也有八千以上！
“老板，今天咱们的营业额，快赶上过去一个月了！”小雅看着电脑上的统计表格，眼睛眯成了月牙儿，笑得合不拢嘴。
“咳，也别太激动，这才第一天，想办法把这些顾客留住，尽量发展成回头客才是最重要的。”
沐游吐了口气。今天的营业额爆炸，主要还是靠他发的那个视频的影响。
然而这种有爆火质量的视频，可遇而不可求。
他们能碰上一次，已经算是运气爆棚了，今后还是得靠他们店铺本身的质量来留下顾客。
一天的营业圆满结束，沐游给小雅转了笔500元的红包，算是犒劳她这一天的辛苦。
“谢谢老板！”

沐游站在店门口，目送着小雅一蹦一跳的离开，默默点了支烟，脑海里回想着从昨晚一直到今天发生的所有事情。
其实在获得时光怀表之后，他想要搞钱已经变得易如反掌，根本用不着每天训练宠物经营店铺这么麻烦，只需去国外那些大赌场里转一圈，想要多少都有了。
然而，沐游始终没有考虑过这种手段，原因很简单：这种剑走偏锋的搞钱方法，极容易暴露自己！
要知道现在地球上可不止他一个玩家，而他放在所有的玩家中，还只是一个才刚开始玩游戏的菜鸟，万一被其他玩家察觉了他的玩家身份，那么……
总之，在目前并不是很缺钱的情况下，当然还是继续照常开店，默默苟发育为妙。
“走一步看一步吧……”
一支烟抽完，沐游碾灭烟头，随手弹进垃圾桶，转回店里。
他可没忘，游戏里还有一格行动力没用呢。
关了店门，沐游掏出手机，愚者启动！
游戏里他刚得到一个全新的职业，还有了自己的房子，正是志得意满之时，沐游迫不及待的操控角色出门，踏上探险的旅途。
【你推开门，走出了打更人的小屋，朝着村庄深处继续探索而去。】
【天色已晚，前方的道路昏暗一片，你不得不
【南瓜灯的光芒，在夜幕的小路上格外显眼。】
【你走出一段，刚到前方路口，忽然看到一只狼人蹲伏在不远处的草丛中。】
【狼人发现了你，狼人朝你扑来！】
【你被狼人咬死了！】
【你已死亡，寿命-1，剩余寿命54年。】
你大爷的，又暴毙了！
沐游之前还想着进了村子，总该不会再有那种一言不合就被小动物咬死的场景，结果游戏转头就给他来了个惊喜。
而且，狼人又是个什么鬼？

沐游仔细看了几遍文本，确定是狼人而不是野狼。
也就是说，这村子还特喵的还是个狼人杀村庄？
这突然出现的新生物，直接打乱了沐游之前的计划：这村子果然也不安全！
角色死亡，沐游本准备立即按下怀表回溯，结果这时，他发现游戏并没有直接结束。
在游戏角色死回家里之后，屏幕下方居然又弹出一段新文本。
【死亡的痛楚过后，你在小木屋的地下室中复活。】
【你刚准备起身，忽然摸到地板上一本落满灰尘的书册。】
【你拿起一看，原来是前任打更人留下的巡逻笔记，上面记载着他每晚打更时的所见所闻。只可惜，这笔记由星灵语书写，想要看懂上面的文字，你需要先学会星灵语。】
【或许你可以去猫头鹰店主那里，向它购买一本《星灵词典》，用于学习星灵语。】
打更笔记？
沐游一愣，这次死回家，似乎刚巧触发了一个新事件，得到了一本笔记。
从名字上看，这应该就是一本打更人写的日记，记录了他每晚打更时经历的事情，如果可以全部翻译出来的话，确实可以从中得到很多星灵界的信息。
只不过，想看懂这日记，又需要先找商人买词典，学会那个世界的语言才行。
“只能等凌晨再说了……”
不管是狼人还是星灵词典，沐游现在都不需要考虑。
今天的体力已经彻底用完，而时间才刚到下午六点，喜提六小时断线惩罚。
接下来的时间他也没有别的事可做，想到晚上还要熬夜出去完成那个‘打更任务’，沐游索性回卧室提前补了个觉。
晚上11:30，沐游准时被闹钟吵醒。
拖着饥肠辘辘的身躯下楼觅食。
解决完晚饭，又去洗漱一番，再一看时间，已经是晚上11:55。

“任务任务！”
凌晨即将到来，在这个城市大多数人都陷入沉睡之际，沐游却是精神抖擞的准备出门。
首次大半夜出门完成打更任务，想想还真点小激动！
当然，为了避免暴露，沐游并没有大摇大摆的走正门，而是跑去一楼的宠物洗浴室，从洗浴间的后窗翻了出去。
他从小在宠物店长大，对这一带熟悉的很，哪里有监控哪里没有，没人比他更清楚。
沐游沿着监控的死角，一路摸到两条街之外的一个废弃小巷内。
躲藏在黑暗之中，在脸上抹了把，切换为了‘打更人’形态。
看着全身浮现的暗红色布衣，沐游这才点亮了南瓜灯，提着灯走出巷子。
content_en:
"Then do you have any other classmates, alumni or the like? Let me introduce you to one. The salary is good!" Mu You asked unwillingly.
"This...I'll try my best..."
Zhao Qian was too embarrassed to refuse in person. After leaving such a sentence, she waved and left.
"What a pity..."
Mu You actually knew that there was little hope. It was indeed a bit unrealistic for graduates from famous universities like Zhao Qian to put aside their status and work in a pet shop.
"Let's talk about it later..."
This matter can only be left alone for now.
Mu You returned to the store and greeted the remaining customers with Xiaoya.
After seeing off all the guests in the afternoon, the two of them lay down in front of the computer at the front desk and took stock of the day's gains.
At the end of the day, the store sold a total of twelve hamsters, seven chinchillas, five rabbits, three golden turtles, six canaries and five koi carps.
In addition, there are a large number of pets that have been marked as reserved by customers and are for sale.
There are also various pet supplies and feeds that customers buy when purchasing pets.
After counting, today's turnover has reached a terrifying more than 15,000 yuan. Even after subtracting costs, the net profit is more than 8,000 yuan!
"Boss, our turnover today has almost caught up with the past month!" Xiaoya looked at the statistical table on the computer, her eyes narrowed into crescents, and she smiled from ear to ear.
"Ahem, don't get too excited. It's only the first day. The most important thing is to find ways to retain these customers and try to develop them into repeat customers."
Mu You breathed out. Today's sales explosion is mainly due to the influence of the video he posted.
However, videos of this explosive quality are hard to come by.
If they can come across it once, they are extremely lucky. In the future, they will still have to rely on the quality of their store to retain customers.
The day's business ended successfully, and Mu You transferred a red envelope of 500 yuan to Xiaoya as a reward for her hard work throughout the day.
"Thank you boss!"
Mu You stood at the door of the store, watching Xiaoya skip away, silently lighting a cigarette, thinking about everything that happened from last night to today.
In fact, after getting the time pocket watch, it has become easy for him to make money. He doesn't need to go to the trouble of training pets to run a shop every day. He only needs to go to those big casinos abroad and he will have as much money as he wants.
However, Mu You has never considered this method. The reason is very simple: this kind of eccentric way of making money can easily expose yourself!
You must know that he is not the only player on the earth now, and among all the players, he is just a rookie who has just started playing the game. If other players discover his identity as a player, then...
In short, as we are not very short of money at present, it is of course better to continue to open the store as usual and develop quietly.
"Let's take a step and see..."
After smoking a cigarette, Mu You crushed the cigarette butt, flicked it into the trash can, and returned to the store.
He didn't forget that there was still an unused action bar in the game.
After closing the store, Mu You took out his mobile phone and activated Fool!
In the game, he has just got a brand new career and his own house. When he is satisfied, Mu You can't wait to control the character to go out and embark on a journey of adventure.

[You walk for a while, and when you reach the intersection ahead, you suddenly see a werewolf crouching in the grass not far away. 】
[The werewolf has discovered you, and the werewolf is rushing towards you! 】
[You were bitten to death by a werewolf! 】
[You have died, your life span is -1, and your remaining life span is 54 years. 】
Your uncle died suddenly again!
Mu You had thought before that after entering the village, there would be no more chance of being teased if someone disagreed with her.He was bitten to death by an animal, but Yugi turned around and gave him a surprise.
And what the hell is a werewolf?
Mu You read the text carefully several times to confirm that it was a werewolf and not a wild wolf.
In other words, what is so special about this village is that it is a werewolf killing village?
The sudden appearance of this new creature directly disrupted Mu You's previous plan: this village is indeed not safe!
When the character died, Mu You was about to press his pocket watch to rewind immediately, but at this time, he discovered that the game did not end directly.
After the game character died and returned home, a new text popped up at the bottom of the screen.
[After the pain of death, you resurrected in the basement of the cabin. 】
[You were just about to get up when you suddenly touched a dusty book on the floor. 】
[You pick it up and look at it. It turns out to be the patrol notes left by the previous watchman. It records what he saw and heard when he was working every night. Unfortunately, this note is written in the Protoss language. If you want to understand the text above, you need to learn the Protoss language first. 】
[Perhaps you can go to the owl shopkeeper and buy a "Protoss Dictionary" from him to learn the Protoss language. 】
Typing notes?
Mu You was stunned. Returning home this time seemed to have happened to trigger a new event and get a notebook.
Judging from the name, this should be a diary written by a clock watcher, recording what he goes through every night during the clock watch. If it can be translated in full, a lot of information about the spiritual world can indeed be obtained from it.
However, if you want to understand this diary, you need to buy a dictionary from a merchant and learn the language of that world.
"We can only wait until the early morning to talk about it..."
Whether it's the Werewolf or the Star Spirit Dictionary, Mu You doesn't need to think about it now.
Today's physical strength has been completely exhausted, and the time has just reached 6 pm, so I am punished by being disconnected for six hours.
He had nothing else to do for the rest of the day. Thinking that he would have to stay up late at night to complete the 'clocking task', Mu You simply went back to the bedroom to catch up on some sleep in advance.
At 11:30 pm, Mu You was woken up by the alarm clock on time.
Dragging his hungry body downstairs to look for food.
After finishing dinner, I went to wash up again. When I looked at the time, it was already 11:55 pm.
"Mission mission!"
The early morning was approaching, and while most people in the city were falling asleep, Mu You was in high spirits and ready to go out.
It was my first time to go out in the middle of the night to complete the clocking task. I was really excited when I thought about it!
Of course, in order to avoid being exposed, Mu You did not walk through the main entrance in a big way. Instead, he ran to the pet bathroom on the first floor and climbed out through the back window of the bathroom.
He grew up in a pet shop and was very familiar with this area. No one knew better than him where there was surveillance and where there was not.
Mu You followed the surveillance blind spot and reached an abandoned alley two streets away.
Hiding in the darkness, he wiped it on his face and switched to the 'watchman' form.
Looking at the dark red cloth floating all over his body, Mu You lit up the pumpkin lantern and walked out of the alley with the lantern.
